episode_title: #139 - La CEO de SHPE 2026!!! | [Suzanna Valdez Wolfe]
question: What two core values drive Suzanna Valdez Wolfe as CEO of SHPE?
transcript_excerpt: Service to others and collaboration are her two main core values. Service to others is rooted in her upbringing by parents and extended family who taught her to make room at the table for others. Collaboration is about co-creating together and thriving off others' energy and wisdom, which she emphasizes through understanding the stories and journeys of SHPE members across regions and chapters.

episode_title: #139 - La CEO de SHPE 2026!!! | [Suzanna Valdez Wolfe]
question: How did Suzanna Valdez Wolfe navigate pursuing higher education as a young Latina with family expectations?
transcript_excerpt: She started at Texas Women's University as a freshman because it was an all-girls university that her family felt was safe. After one year she returned home and completed two years at UTEP, then worked full-time for a year before returning to school at Pan American University, now UTRGB. She emphasizes that college journeys are not always straight lines and that finding your why makes the pursuit worth it.

episode_title: #139 - La CEO de SHPE 2026!!! | [Suzanna Valdez Wolfe]
question: What is the membership size and founding year of SHPE?
transcript_excerpt: SHPE has been thriving for 52 years with membership growing to 20,000 plus members. This growth is a testament to the mission and the people involved in the organization, from volunteers to staff to board members.

episode_title: #139 - La CEO de SHPE 2026!!! | [Suzanna Valdez Wolfe]
question: How does Suzanna Valdez Wolfe balance being a working mother, daughter, and professional leader?
transcript_excerpt: She acknowledges the complexity of being part of the sandwich generation, caring for her 91-year-old father in San Antonio while living in Miami and managing her CEO role. She emphasizes making choices based on what matters most, being grounded in faith, and rejecting the myth of having it all, noting that there are different seasons in life and it is important to give oneself permission.

episode_title: #139 - La CEO de SHPE 2026!!! | [Suzanna Valdez Wolfe]
question: What surprised Suzanna Valdez Wolfe most after becoming CEO of SHPE?
transcript_excerpt: Her biggest surprise is that SHPE is a Latino organization leading in so many ways, with top talent in the world who are innovators, creators, and pioneers discovering what is next in their industries. She was also struck by the size of the organization, the familia aspect, and the energy and connection felt at national conventions.
